what: dawn sun at 1080p, 90 deg, camera aimed at the sun (az 30, el 5.8), S6 grade with bloom; 1:1 crops dawn_sun_1080_0EV.png / dawn_sun_1080_VR-0.6EV.png (400 x 240 px around the sun). Profile = mean display luminance (codes) on rings at 0 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 8 / 12 deg, upper half (the horizon below is its own thing).
